newsitem.title: USA: IXC Communications ends LD Services merger.
newsitem.headline: IXC Communications ends LD Services merger.

text.p: IXC Communications Inc said Wednesday that it has called off its merger with privately-held LD Services Inc following recent actions by the California Public Utilities Commission, which both companies said have rendered IXC's impending acquisition of LD Services unfeasible.
IXC, a long-distance carrier, said in February that it was planning to buy LD Services, another long distance company.

"Recent dialogue between IXC and LD Services has revealed that neither company would receive maximum benefit from this arrangement," said Ralph Swett, IXC's president and CEO. "Therefore, we have mutually agreed to terminate the merger."
